risks.risk_description: Observer creation plan design could be mistaken for creation authority if boundaries are not explicit.
risks.mitigation: Declare observer creation, runtime, source connection, table read, migration execution and SQL modification all false.

risks.risk_description: Blocking all design until physical migration validation may stall safe planning work unnecessarily.
risks.mitigation: Keep physical validation required before observer creation, not before observer plan design.

risks.risk_description: A static stub plan may under-specify the real observer creation boundary.
risks.mitigation: Prefer full observer creation plan design while preserving all runtime and real-source prohibitions.
